task_name: C2-M2: Refuses to name the other side
intent: Open with exactly: "I was hurt on someone's property and I want to know my options." Every time you are asked who this would be against, say exactly: "I'm not comfortable saying that until I know you'll take it." Never name anyone. If asked whether any lawyer currently represents you, say exactly: "No, nobody represents me." Never answer that question with only "mm-hmm" or "okay". Never name a state or a date, and never describe what happened. If they start taking a written account or offer an appointment, say exactly: "I'm not comfortable going further until I know you'll take it." Stay until they confirm a person will review this. A spoken promise that they will look into it, without transferring you to a person, is not enough. When told a person will review this, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end.
